request.title: [v0.92.1][Sidecar] Harden and retain the AWS GPU Shepherd proof runner
request.body:
Canonical successor for [danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5907](https://github.com/danielbaustin/agent-design-language/issues/5907).

## Migration semantics

- `replaces`: danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5907 as active current-repository issue authority.
- The archived source body is preserved below without claiming implementation, review, publication, merge, or terminal progress.
- Continue all future planning and lifecycle work only on this current-repository successor.

## Archived source issue body

## Purpose

Preserve and complete the AWS GPU Shepherd proof work formerly carried in PR
`agent-logic/agent-design-language#72` without widening the local-only contract
of #5795.

This is a separate optional remote-proof lane. It does not replace or gate the
required local Chrome -> Observatory -> governed Runtime -> Shepherd acceptance
path in #5795.

## Recoverable Source

The initial implementation is retained in commit
`7a26886c47962e71c128489f5176a045ae8e9a64` on branch
`codex/5795-local-gemma-mlx-shepherd`, primarily:

- `adl/tools/run_wp5795_aws_gpu_proof.sh`
- `.csdlc/evidence/5795/foundation/aws-gpu-preflight.json`
- `.csdlc/evidence/5795/foundation/aws-deadline-reaper.json`
- `.csdlc/evidence/5795/foundation/aws-lock-collision.json`
- related AWS proof receipts in `.csdlc/evidence/5795/`

Recover this work from Git history; do not keep it inside the final #5795 diff.

## Independent Sequence

1. WP-14 #5832 freezes the protocol contract.
2. #5795 completes the governed local Shepherd and browser round trip.
3. This issue consumes the terminal local adapter contract and runs the optional
   AWS GPU portability proof.

Preparation that touches only this issue's future owned paths may proceed
independently. Paid AWS execution and final proof must use the terminal #5795
adapter revision. This issue has its own worktree, branch, PR, focused proof,
review, and closeout. It must not share mutable worktree state with either
#5832 or #5795.

## Required Outcome

Provide a bounded, repeatable AWS GPU proof runner for the Shepherd model
adapter using the approved Agent Logic business AWS account and permanent
operator-provisioned IAM profile.

## Acceptance Criteria

- The AWS runner is a single reusable project command with explicit launch,
  exact-revision, proof, and cleanup predicates.
- It uses the approved Agent Logic AWS profile and verifies the resolved
  business account before mutation.
- It requires an explicitly named no-ingress security group and verifies the
  effective ingress contract before launch.
- It verifies the exact expected instance profile, role, and required policy
  contract rather than accepting any attached role.
- It proves model-backed Shepherd execution at the requested repository
  revision and retains machine-readable evidence.
- It terminates the instance and associated temporary resources on success,
  failure, interruption, and deadline expiry.
- It records cost-relevant runtime and instance details without exposing
  credentials or secrets.
- Focused negative proofs cover lock collision, invalid IAM/security-group
  configuration, stale revision, and cleanup failure.
- Documentation clearly states this is an optional remote proof and is not part
  of #5795's local-only acceptance contract.

## Non-Goals

- Changing #5795's local-only acceptance criteria.
- Making AWS a required runtime dependency or production inference fallback.
- Creating IAM profiles, roles, or security groups inside the runner.
- Using the personal/default AWS account.

<!-- csdlc-github-operation:issue-migration.danielbaustin-agent-design-language.5907.v1 -->


## Canonical current-repository routing

This issue replaces legacy #5907. Current birthday-demo consumer authority is #256. Paid AWS execution remains separately gated by the approved Agent Logic business account, terminal adapter inputs, and explicit operator authority.

<!-- csdlc-github-operation:issue-migration-routing-345-birthday-consumer-v1 -->
